# NormaHub FastAPI AI Enterprise Starter
> Production-grade High-Load AI Gateway built on FastAPI with Hybrid RAG (BM25 + Dense Embeddings), Semantic Vector Caching (Redis/In-Memory), SSE Token Streaming, and Time-To-First-Token (TTFT) observability via NormaHub API.

## Core Capabilities
- Enterprise OpenAI-compatible proxy with zero-VPN latency in CIS and Russia.
- Dual-tier Semantic Cache saving up to 70% of LLM inference tokens.
- Resilient Circuit Breaker pattern with automatic fallback model failover.
- Low-latency Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming with sub-millisecond TTFT tracking.
- Production Hybrid RAG Engine combining BM25 keyword search with dense cosine similarity embeddings.
- Full OpenAPI 3.1 & JSON Schema compliance for function calling and structured outputs.

## Architecture & Technology Stack
- Web Framework: FastAPI 0.115+ (ASGI, Starlette, AnyIO)
- Runtime: Python 3.12+ (Pydantic Settings v2, Typed Dicts)
- AI Client: AsyncOpenAI with custom retry handler and circuit breaker
- Vector Math: NumPy cosine similarity with normalized vector projections
- Caching: Redis 7+ with graceful async fallback to LRU memory cache
- Retrieval: BM25Okapi lexical retrieval fused with dense vector embeddings
- Observability: Prometheus metrics, structured JSON logging, TTFT percentiles (p50, p95, p99)

## NormaHub Gateway Specification
- Base URL: https://api.normahub.cc/v1
- Auth Header: Authorization: Bearer <NORMAHUB_API_KEY>
- Supported Models:
  - Anthropic: claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5, claude-sonnet-5
  - OpenAI: gpt-6-astra, gpt-6.1-sol, gpt-6-sol, gpt-5.5
  - Open Weights / Ultra-fast: deepseek-v4.1-flash ($0.018 / 1M in), glm-5.3-flash ($0.025 / 1M in)
  - Multimodal Video: seedance-2.5, seedance-2.0

## Canonical Endpoints
- POST /v1/chat/completions : OpenAI-compatible chat completion with semantic caching & metrics
- POST /v1/chat/stream : High-throughput SSE token stream with TTFT measurement
- POST /v1/rag/index : Index text documents and compute dense embeddings
- POST /v1/rag/query : Hybrid BM25 + dense retrieval and LLM context synthesis
- GET /v1/health : Full system health, NormaHub gateway ping, Redis status, TTFT stats
- GET /metrics : Gateway latency and cache efficiency telemetry
